stories.title: Cheong Wa Dae says no details finalized after Lutnick's remarks on 'targeted' chip tariff
stories.summary: No details have been finalized on any new U.S. tariffs on semiconductors, the presidential office here said Thursday, after the U.S. commerce secretary said a "targeted" chip tariff policy is under consideration. Appearing on a CNBC interview Wednesday (U.S. time), Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said the U.S. administration is considering a "targeted" and "thoughtful" tariff policy for semiconductors. "As far as we know, details related to U.S. semiconductor tariffs have not been finalized," an official at Cheong Wa Dae said. "The government will closely monitor related developments while closely cooperating with the U.S. to prevent any unfavorable impact on our companies," the official said.

stories.title: Tesla tops imported car sales in S. Korea for 7th straight month in August
stories.summary: U.S. electric vehicle (EV) maker Tesla was the bestselling imported passenger car brand in South Korea for the seventh consecutive month in August, industry data showed Thursday. According to the Korea Automobile Importers & Distributors Association (KAIDA), 29,817 imported passenger cars were newly registered last month, up 9.2 percent from a year earlier. Tesla led the market with 10,400 units, maintaining the top spot since February. BMW ranked second with 6,180, followed by Mercedes-Benz with 3,959 and China's BYD with 2,846. The Tesla Model Y Premium was the bestselling imported model last month, with 7,490 units sold. Driven by strong demand for EVs from brands such as Tesla and BYD, EVs accounted for about half of all imported passenger car registrations, totaling 15,183 units in August.
